title: A Radiation-Hardened, Fault-Aware Quantized Neural Network That Self-Heals
abstract: arXiv:2610.27621v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning (DL) models are increasingly being deployed into radiation-challenging environments in spacecraft, particle accelerators, and, soon, space-based data centers. Instantiated as a learned orchestration of numbers stored in persistent memory, models are susceptible to continual degradation as high-energy particles corrupt data. At inference time, new data passed through the network fundamentally break the off-line assumptions and guarantees of a static model determined during training. To preserve the quality and efficacy of the models, fault tolerance against bit flips is a clear objective. In this work we developed a runtime method for repairing the quantized weights of neural networks (NNs) after bit flips on commodity, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) hardware, without storing extra replicas. translated_title: 一种具备抗辐射能力、故障感知且可自修复的量化神经网络
translated_abstract: 深度学习（DL）模型正日益被部署到辐射环境恶劣的场合中，例如航天器、粒子加速器，以及不久后的天基数据中心。模型作为存储在持久性存储器中的数值所构成的学习编排实例，在高质量能粒子破坏数据时容易发生持续的性能退化。在推理阶段，流经网络的新数据从根本上打破了训练期间所确定的静态模型的离线假设与保障。为了保持模型的质量和效能，针对位翻转的容错能力是一个明确的目标。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种运行时方法，用于在商用现货（COTS）硬件上发生位翻转后修复神经网络（NN）的量化权重，而无需存储额外的副本。我们的工作扩展了成熟的故障感知训练（FAT）范式，通过添加对齐惩罚项来集中未受损的……
tldr: 本文提出一种抗辐射的故障感知量化神经网络，通过扩展故障感知训练范式，使模型能在商用现货硬件上于运行时自修复位翻转导致的权重损坏，且无需存储额外副本。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a radiation-hardened, fault-aware quantized neural network that extends the Fault-Aware Training paradigm to enable runtime self-healing of bit-flip corrupted weights on commodity COTS hardware without storing extra replicas.
